message:
Manager, Solar Energy Systems Engineer, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the filled box stands safe on soft ground on a complete count.

In plain words a small car weight on six feet stays well below soft soil capacity using the same box size that sets heat leak. Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) panels weigh 12.05 kg per square metre at 100 mm thickness from the Insulated PUR PIR Sandwich Panel 100mm Cold Room Panels Roof Cladding (E116) and the same panel datasheet from the Insulated PUR PIR Sandwich Panel 100mm Cold Room Panels Roof Cladding (E117), which sets panel mass 306 kg on 25.4 square metres. Complete superstructure is produce 1000 plus crates 93.5 plus racking 90 plus panels 306 plus door 45 plus battery 110 plus eutectic 120 plus monoblock 55 plus frames 185 plus nine Photovoltaic (PV, solar electricity) modules 180 plus wiring 25 equals 2210 kg in the complete superstructure mass sum (E118), about one small car so everyday scale holds. Chamber share on six 400 mm pads gives 19.8 kPa in the chamber structure soil pressure (E119) below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet | PDF | Strength Of Materials | Precast Concrete (E62), factor about eight, using interior 8.64 cubic metres from the interior volume estimate (E39) with envelope 25.4 square metres from the envelope area square metres (E40) giving conduction 203 W from the conduction watts at 43C ambient 5C room (E41), so the same envelope controls conduction.

In plain words the box feet and the panel feet are separate paths and wind lift is tied down with sealed holes. Small ground screws give 1.70 kN tension each from the Ground Screw Pole Anchor (E114), while screw anchors in soft-plastic clay give 4.83 to 5.10 kN uplift from the Nghiên cứu giải pháp neo xoắn để gia cường ổn định cho cấu kiện bảo vệ mái kênh công trình thủy lợi TT TIENG ANH (E115), so I use the conservative 1.70 kN value. Chamber path is box to plinth to six pads, roof gantry path is two modules to gantry to box pads with vent gap, ground path is seven modules to ground frame to own footings in the split layout sketch (E70) and the grown split sketch (E85) from module size in the PRBS 400W Monocrystalline Photovoltaic Panels | Commercial & High-Performance (E64). Wind 375 Pa at 25 metres per second in the wind pressure at 25 m per s gust (E120) on 17.6 square metres from the nine-module footprint for grown array (E84) lifts 673 kg in the wind uplift mass equivalent kg for 9-module frame (E90), about nine adults so anchoring matters, held by eight screws giving 1390 kg hold in the anchor hold mass equivalent eight anchors (E123) with field pull test still needed, with gasket plus flashing at rear penetration and trapped drain to outside bucket and clamped gasket at soft curtain to rigid PIR to steel racking, pending joint confirmation with Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer.

In plain words fifty crates fit with air lanes and one-crate door discipline. Dimensioned plan 2.40 by 1.80 m with two rack rows each 25 crates of 600 by 400 mm with 25 mm gaps plus section 2.00 m high with high rear evaporator to low return loop and 900 mm door swing clear in the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124) holds 50 crates from the crates for 1 tonne check (E77) for 1000 kg from the total produce mass estimate (E49) with staged 12.5 crates per day from the daily crates for 250kg staged intake (E78), using 8-opening curtain discipline from the Designing Efficient Cold Storage: Key Factors and Cooling Loads (E51) with 900 mm single-leaf door from the Coolroom Buying Guide: Walk-In Refrigeration for Kitchens (E71). My position is ready on enclosure and support, because complete mass, soil pressure, separate paths, quantified uplift hold and crate layout now close except field pull test and 43 degree pull-down bench test needing built hardware.
